note: Every rule this skill gains must either replace something or say why it replaces nothing. The requirement exists because the skill's own first invariant says to correct a violation at its cause rather than add an incident-specific clause, and thirteen commits of +14000/-730 show that nothing was enforcing it.

additions.supersedes_nothing_because: It is the first check on a field nothing checked before. `validate` accepts a document whose ownership disagrees with what its batches write, whose presentation index is stale, or whose convergence status contradicts its own lists; these codes report exactly that. Each one is pinned to a mechanical case, so a later round can retire it against evidence rather than taste.
